api_key_secret_ref.description: AlienVault OTX API key. Stored as a credential rule, not on the assignment form.

bootstrap_lookback_days.description: When modified_since is empty, start or recover the walk from this many days ago instead of using the unreliable full-corpus deep-page export. Set 0 explicitly to request full history.

types.description: Comma-delimited OTX indicator types to fetch

max_pages.description: Maximum OTX pages fetched in one plugin run. Incomplete cursors resume on the next scheduled invocation.

max_retries.description: Transient-failure retry budget for one emitted page. Moving to an equivalent smaller page does not consume retries. Auth and other non-retryable 4xx errors fail fast.

backoff_ms.description: Base retry backoff in milliseconds; bounded exponential (factor 2) with equal jitter, capped at 30000ms

min_pull_interval_ms.description: Self-throttle window: a fresh OTX pull runs at most once per this interval (default ~24h) even if the agent runs the check more often. Set 0 to disable throttling. Partial (paged) walks always resume regardless of this window.
